hooks.command: printf %s '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"When you need a decision or an answer from the user before you can continue, ask it with the AskUserQuestion tool, not as plain text at the end of your reply. The user watches a dashboard that shows an agent as waiting only while such a question is open."}}'

hooks.prompt:
You check how a coding agent ended its turn. Hook input:
$ARGUMENTS

If last_assistant_message says the AskUserQuestion tool is unavailable or cannot be used, respond {"ok": true}.

Otherwise read last_assistant_message (any language). Respond {"ok": false, ...} only if it contains an actual question addressed to the user that the agent needs answered before it can continue, such as a choice between options or facts only the user knows. These do NOT count: a report of finished work, a courtesy offer like 'let me know if you need anything', and text that only talks about questions, tools or instructions without asking anything.

If it asks, respond {"ok": false, "reason": "Your last message asks the user a question. Ask it again with the AskUserQuestion tool (same language, concise options) instead of plain text, so the user's dashboard shows that you are waiting."}
Otherwise respond {"ok": true}.

Respond with JSON only.
